operating_notes.text: PNC is L1 for two HAM packages on NH-927 in Uttar Pradesh: Barabanki–Mustafabad (₹1,728 Cr) and Mustafabad–Biswariya (₹1,755 Cr), aggregate ₹3,483 Cr excl. GST, 24 months' execution each.
Accepted NHAI's ₹234.72 Cr settlement offer under Vivad-se-Vishwas III Scheme for the Agra Bypass Project arbitration award.
PNC is L1 bidder for a ₹194.40 Cr EPC flyover (4 lanes, 2 loops, 2 ramps) at Shaheed Path, Lucknow, for Lucknow Development Authority, 24-month completion, exclusive of GST.
Subsidiary Prayagraj Kaushambi Highway Package 3 Private Limited received PCOD for the ₹819 Cr NH-731A HAM project effective 31 March 2026.
PNC Infratech (50:50 JV with SPS Constructions India) emerged L1 bidder for ₹571.81 Cr EPC bridge over Ganga River connecting Trans Ganga City to Kanpur City, 36-month execution.
Received Letter of Acceptance for negotiated ₹559.53 Cr EPC Ganga bridge project (excluding GST), 36-month execution period.
Appointed Mr. Chakresh Kumar Jain, Managing Director, as Chief Financial Officer of the Company.
Completed sale of 12th SPV (PNC Challakere Highways Pvt Ltd) on March 17, 2026 to Verto Infrastructure Trust.
Remaining value of contracts under execution stands at over ₹18,094 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Received Letters of Acceptance from NHAI for two HAM highway projects on NH-927 in Uttar Pradesh for an aggregate BPC of ₹3,483 Cr (excluding GST).
Received net of TDS from NHAI under a 12 May 2026 Vivad Se Vishwas III settlement of ₹234.99 Cr for the Agra Bypass EPC dispute.
Unextended order book stands at over ₹22,000 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
L1 bidder for AAI's Pantnagar Airport EPC project at a quoted ₹302.44 Cr excluding GST, completion period 24 months.
Received LOA for ₹194.40 Cr flyover project in Lucknow with a 24-month execution period.
Delhi High Court granted stay on NHAI debarment orders dated September 11, 2026 and September 03, 2026 against PNC Infratech and Awadh Expressway.
Delhi High Court granted a stay on September 13, 2026 against NHAI debarment orders issued in September 2026.
Pronounced an arbitration award for ₹244 crores in favour of the Company for the Sonauli to Gorakhpur EPC project.
Incorporated a subsidiary 'PNC Infratech (Kazakhstan) LLP' in the Republic of Kazakhstan for infrastructure services.
Order book includes projects worth ₹1,393 Cr where appointed date is awaited.

timeline.summary: 21 Apr 2026: PNC Infratech emerged L1 bidder for two NHAI HAM projects on NH-927 in Uttar Pradesh with an aggregate bid project cost of ₹3,483 Cr, exclusive of GST.
On May 5, 2026, PNC Infratech accepted NHAI's ₹234.72 Cr settlement offer for the Agra Bypass Project arbitration award under the Vivad-se-Vishwas III Scheme.
7 May 2026: PNC Infratech emerged L1 bidder for a ₹194.40 Cr EPC flyover at Shaheed Path, Lucknow, for Lucknow Development Authority, with a 24-month completion period.
NSE Sustainability Ratings and Analytics assigned PNC Infratech an independent ESG rating of 49 for FY25.

On 8 May 2026, PNC Infratech announced that its subsidiary Prayagraj Kaushambi Highway Package 3 Private Limited received the provisional completion certificate for the ₹819 Cr NH-731A HAM project effective 31 March 2026.
9 May 2026: PNC Infratech notified a board meeting on 19 May 2026 to approve audited standalone and consolidated FY26 results and consider a dividend, if any.
Declared L1 bidder in a 50:50 JV for a ₹571.81 Cr 4-lane Ganga bridge EPC project by UP State Bridge Corporation.
Received Letter of Acceptance for ₹559.53 Cr Ganga river bridge EPC project from UP State Bridge Corporation Ltd.
PNC Infratech reported Q4FY26 financial results; and completed divestment of its 12th road asset SPV.
On 20 May 2026, PNC Infratech released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹5,368 Cr and an order book of ₹18,094 Cr.
PNC Infratech Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 20, 2026, with investors and analysts.
PNC Infratech received Letters of Acceptance from NHAI for two HAM highway projects worth ₹3,483 Cr.
PNC Infratech hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call on 20 May 2026, guiding for ~30% revenue growth in FY27 to ₹6,000 Cr and reporting an unexecuted order book of over ₹22,000 Cr.
PNC Infratech emerged as L1 bidder for the Airports Authority of India's Pantnagar Airport EPC project, quoted at ₹302.44 Cr excluding GST with a 24-month completion period.
PNC Infratech received a formal LOA for a ₹194.40 Cr flyover EPC project from Lucknow Development Authority on June 1, 2026.
On October 13, 2026, PNC Infratech announced that the Delhi High Court stayed NHAI's debarment orders against the company and Awadh Expressway Private Limited.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,322.47 Cr (+17.3% YoY), net profit ₹114.68 Cr.
PNC Infratech reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,322 Cr and secured a stay from the Delhi High Court against NHAI debarment orders.
Audio recording of earnings call held with Investors and Analysts on October 29, 2026 to discuss un-audited financial results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
